target.statement: sSFFS (y=100) achieves MultinomNB holdout accuracy 0.867 at subset size d=100 on Reuters-21578 Apté split, using the multinomial Bhattacharyya filter criterion.
target.table_ref: Table (Reuters-21578 results, row 'sSFFS y=100', column 'd = 100', sub-column 'acc')
target.dataset: Reuters-21578, Distribution 1.0, Apté split (10,105 term features, 8,941 documents, 33 categories)

compute.basis: The paper reports the full Reuters run costs ~2 minutes of single-core evaluation work, but an AI agent must first implement sSFFS (softmax sampling, exploration floor, online z-standardized contrast statistics, warm-up, floating schedule) and the multinomial Bhattacharyya filter from the paper text, then download and parse the Reuters-21578 Apté split; the 2-minute figure excludes implementation and data preparation, which dominate the agent's command time.

blockers: No code links are present in the PDF; the promised standalone implementation and configuration files are not accessible from the paper text, so the method must be re-implemented from the description.
Reuters-21578 must be downloaded and converted to the Apté split (ModApte) with the 33-category multinomial setup; the paper does not provide a ready-made preprocessed version.
The exact random split protocol (RR(1,50,40) per seed) and the seed-1 split are not fully specified, so exact reproduction of the reported 0.867 may require reverse-engineering the split.
title: Stochastic Sequential Search in Very-High-Dimensional Feature Selection
